methodology_and_limitations.sampling_strategy: 100,000 uniformly sampled pairs without replacement per evaluation
methodology_and_limitations.effective_rank_definition: Roy & Vetterli (2007) Shannon entropy of normalized singular values: exp(-sum p_i ln p_i) where p_i = sigma_i / sum(sigma). Covariance eigenvalues used for exact computation.
methodology_and_limitations.centering: Mean-centered across tokens to distinguish directional cone (anisotropy) from dimensional variance collapse (low rank).
methodology_and_limitations.sequence_length_limitation: For sequence length L < d (where d=384), algebraic rank is strictly bounded by min(L, d) = L. Effective rank cannot exceed L. Cross-state comparisons must use matched length L.
